contract: Open one fresh unknown-length, forward-only AVC/AAC TS188 session, including file opening and reads in the measured operation.
Read input windows of at most 4096 bytes through the forward-only source.
Retain two complete units per stream plus an incoming unit, folding output on eviction and EOF.
Fold exact signed AVC PTS, DTS, raw33 source clocks, IDR, raster and complete Annex B bytes.
Fold AAC source PTS/DTS, resolved presentation, duration, rate, channels, sample count and complete ADTS bytes.
Combine the video stream count and fold followed by the audio stream count and fold, releasing source and session before returning.
Require delivery and retained-unit retirement before EOF for the three timing inputs. Both short controls use the same operation with progress checked at EOF.
Require all three comparable inputs for correctness, runtime and memory. Validate all five functional inputs and their ten per-engine literal outcomes before measurement.
